You'll be based in our London office, at the heart of day-to-day operations — responsible for the accurate quality control, packing, and shipping of diamonds and gemstones moving through Nivoda's marketplace. This is a role for someone who takes real pride in getting the small things right, thrives under pressure, and wants to play a part in scaling a global business from the ground up. What will you be doing? 😎 Quality Control: Inspect incoming and outgoing diamonds and gemstones to ensure they meet quality standards. Sending & Receiving Shipments: Coordinate domestic and international shipments to both suppliers and customers. Packing & Shipping: Physically packing a high volume of orders and ensuring that these are accurately labeled, packaged, and documented for delivery. Customer collections : Preparing and assisting customers with their collection of orders General order Fulfillment: Assist in processing customer orders, ensuring that the right items are picked, packed, and shipped on time. Melee order Fulfillment: Counting and weighing melee diamonds, ensuring that the right orders are picked, packed, and shipped on time. Office Admin: Support in managing the general administrative work related to the office. Collections: Collect stones from suppliers in the local area to QC and process in office. Collaboration : Communicate with internal teams to ensure the smooth distribution of orders and managing customer requests. What do we need from you? 💪 A minimum of 1 year hands-on gemmological experience or a diamond grading qualification. Confident working in Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Drive, Gmail, Slides) and Slack in a fast-moving, channel-based team. Exceptional attention to detail – every document filed and every parcel handled needs to be right, every time. A high level of professionalism, discretion, and integrity when handling valuable assets and customer information. The ability to prioritise high-value shipments and tasks with precision in a fast-paced environment. A friendly, responsible, and proactive attitude – someone keen to learn and grow into new responsibilities. Nice to have ✨ GIA or Gem A qualification Prior exposure to or experience in diamond or gemstone quality control. Our culture and what we offer 😉 At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning, and growth where everyone can bring their expertise, own projects, and easily measure their impact. Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company. Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment. Engage in intellectually challenging work that contributes significantly to Nivoda's success and scalability. Our current benefits 🕰️ A vibrant company culture 🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning 🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase Equal Opportunity Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts - don't let it stop you. We are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable. Please note: Our Talent Acquisition Team is international. We kindly ask you to submit your CV and application in English so that it can be reviewed correctly. This is a full time, permanent position that's 100% on-site in London, UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to offer sponsorship at this time. Not quite the right fit? title: Senior Software Engineer, Sandboxes (EU or East Coast Preferred)
description: Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default. The Docker Sandboxes team is building the runtime that lets AI coding agents run safely on a developer's machine: disposable, isolated microVM sandboxes that each get their own Docker daemon, filesystem, and network. This is the core of Docker's sbx product: developers can give an agent the autonomy it needs to get real work done without it ever touching the host, and tear the whole environment down when it's finished. The successful candidate is a technical, product-minded engineer with deep experience building secure, isolated runtime environments (sandboxes, containers, or VMs) and a track record of shipping and owning that kind of infrastructure in production at scale. They think naturally about isolation and security boundaries, understand the tradeoffs involved in running untrusted or semi-trusted workloads safely, and can reason confidently about a system that spans multiple surface areas. They can drive clarity and consensus on hard, ambiguous problems that cross team and component boundaries, raise the bar for engineering quality wherever they work, thrive in a remote-first environment, communicate clearly across time zones, work with our users, while bringing curiosity and craftsmanship to hard problems. Please note: this role is currently prioritizing candidates currently located in the Eastern time zone (US or Canada), or in the EU. Investigate and resolve correctness, performance, and stability issues in the agent integration layer across macOS, Windows, and Linux. Collaborate with peers, Product, and adjacent teams to evolve the architecture as requirements grow. Mentor engineers on the team and set the bar in design reviews and code reviews. Engage with the open source and agentic development community around sandboxing, MCP, and related ecosystems. Participate in on-call rotations and respond to critical stability issues affecting users. Document your work clearly and share knowledge with the rest of the team. Qualifications 8+ years of software engineering experience, with demonstrated technical leadership on production systems at scale. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Experience building developer tools, desktop applications, or runtime infrastructure used directly by developers. Familiarity with the agentic software development ecosystem: how coding agents work and how tools like Claude Code, Codex, or similar agents interact with their environment. Ability to reason about isolation and security boundaries: what a sandbox should and shouldn't expose, and how to make safe defaults obvious to users. Experience driving architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineers or teams. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy in a remote-first environment. What to Expect First 30 Days Build an understanding of our codebase. Become a recognized technical owner of key parts of the codebase and a go-to technical leader for the local runtime. Help us define the longer-term technical strategy for the filesystem layer in a way that fits with Product and Business goals, and rally the team behind it. About Ultralytics:

At Ultralytics, we commit to relentless innovation in the AI space and seek team members who resonate with our ambition to produce the world's best YOLO AI models. If you're obsessed with AI, eager to make an impact on the world, and thrive in dynamic, high-intensity environments, we invite you to apply for a position on our team.

🌍 Join the team powering the future of vision AI
Hello, hola, 你好, こんにちは, नमस्ते, hallo, bonjour! Thanks for stopping by — we know your time is valuable, so here's what makes Ultralytics special.

⚡ Who we are
At Ultralytics, we're on a mission to simplify AI for everyone. As the creators of the world's leading Ultralytics YOLO models, we empower millions of developers, researchers, and companies worldwide to build state-of-the-art computer vision applications.

Following our $30M Series A round, we're expanding rapidly across our global hubs in London, Madrid, and Shenzhen. This is an opportunity to join a fast-scaling, high-performance team that's redefining the future of vision AI — where ambition meets impact, and ideas become reality.

We move fast. We build boldly. We execute with purpose. And we do it together.

💼 About the role
Ultralytics is hiring its first in-house lawyer. There's no legal team to join — you're building it. That means setting up how contracts get reviewed, collaborating with outside counsel across jurisdictions, and deciding what processes are actually worth having at a company this size, rather than inheriting someone else's playbook.

The first priority is the part of the business that generates revenue directly: the AGPL-3.0 and Enterprise dual-licensing model behind YOLO. Every company using Ultralytics' models commercially either open-sources their entire project under AGPL-3.0 or buys an Enterprise license. Supporting compliance, converting violations into contracts, and negotiating Enterprise agreements are core to the P&L, not a background compliance task. We need someone who's done this kind of work before, not someone learning open-source licensing on the job.

🚀 What you'll do

Open-source licensing and IP

  • Own the AGPL-3.0 and Enterprise licensing model end to end: detect likely violations, lead outreach and negotiation to convert unlicensed commercial use into paid Enterprise agreements.

  • Structure and negotiate enterprise license agreements directly with customers — scope, pricing triggers, audit rights, term.

  • Own IP portfolio strategy and lifecycle (trademarks, copyright, trade secrets), working with external IP agents and attorneys for filings and renewals rather than filing directly.

  • Set and maintain the open-source contribution and dependency policy — what can come in, what obligations it carries, how attribution and notices are handled.


Commercial contracts

  • Draft, review, and negotiate SaaS, licensing, distribution, partnership, and vendor agreements.

  • Build contract templates, playbooks, fallback positions, and approval workflows from the ground up.

  • Own liability, indemnity, warranty, and risk positions across customer and vendor contracts.

  • Partner with Sales, Operations, Finance, Product, and Engineering to close deals and manage legal risk.


Privacy, compliance, and legal operations

  • Advise on GDPR, data processing agreements, and international data transfers across the UK, EU, US, and China.

  • Establish proportionate AI governance and regulatory compliance processes.

  • Select and manage outside counsel across the UK, Spain, China, and other jurisdictions as needed.

  • Introduce practical systems for matter management, contract tracking, legal intake, and reporting.


🧠 Skills and experience

Core requirements

  • UK-qualified solicitor or equivalent, with genuine experience working across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Hands-on experience negotiating or enforcing copyleft/open-source licenses, including AGPL, GPL, or similar models.

  • Experience converting unauthorized commercial use into paying licensing customers.

  • Strong track record of drafting and negotiating SaaS, technology licensing, distribution, and other commercial agreements independently.

  • Comfortable operating as the sole in-house lawyer and building a legal function from scratch.

  • Working knowledge of GDPR, data processing agreements, and cross-border data transfers.

  • Excellent judgment, commercial awareness, written communication, and stakeholder management.


Nice to have

  • In-house experience at an AI, computer vision, or open-source software company.

  • Familiarity with Ultralytics, YOLO, or comparable dual-licensed open-source projects.

  • Experience with SCA tooling, SPDX, SBOMs, or license-scanning tools.

  • Experience with AI governance, emerging technology regulation, or software IP enforcement.

  • Spanish, Mandarin, or another relevant language.


🌟 Cultural fit

At Ultralytics, we set bold goals and execute with speed, precision, and teamwork. We're driven by hard work, ambition, and resilience — building fast, learning constantly, and delivering measurable impact.

This is an intense startup environment. You'll be expected to work with urgency, take full ownership, make decisions without perfect information, and deliver high-quality work at pace.

You'll thrive here if you:

  • Take ownership and deliver results with focus and accountability.

  • Combine strategic legal judgment with hands-on execution.

  • Communicate clearly and turn complexity into practical action.

  • Value excellence, grit, and creativity in equal measure.

  • See collaboration as the foundation for meaningful progress.


Our culture is built around our core values:

  • Relentless progress: Constant evolution and improvement.

  • Strive for excellence: Perseverance and attention to detail.

  • Actions, not words: Focus on delivering meaningful results.

  • Act with urgency: Seize fleeting opportunities.

  • Open access to all: Transparent communication and collaboration.


Learn more in our Ultralytics Handbook.

💰 Compensation and benefits
We reward excellence and impact — not just tenure or title.

  • Competitive salary: Reflecting your experience and contribution.

  • Equity packages: We want our success to be yours too.

  • On-site collaboration: Work with passionate builders in our London hub.

  • Flexible working hours: We value results over routines.

  • Generous time off: 24 vacation days, your birthday off, plus local holidays.

  • Tech & tools: Work on cutting-edge AI projects that power millions of devices.

  • Gear: Brand-new Apple MacBook Air/Pro, Apple Studio Display, and AirPods Pro 3.

  • Learning & development: Dedicated budget for personal and professional growth.

  • High impact: Your work will shape the future of vision AI.


🌎 Where and how you can work
We believe great work happens where passion meets purpose.

  • This role is hybrid at our London, UK hub.

  • Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the United Kingdom.


We're an in-office team that values daily collaboration, energy, and connection. Being together helps us move faster, learn from one another, and celebrate wins as they happen.

🚀 Why join us
We're not just building models — we're building the ecosystem powering the future of vision AI. If you're ready to build a legal function from the ground up, protect and grow a global open-source business, and make an impact — this is your moment.

⚡ Ready to help build the legal foundation for the future of vision AI? Apply now.

What we offer:

Cutting-Edge, Next-Generation AI Computer Vision Technology: Contribute to building cutting-edge computer vision AI models based on the YOLO framework.

Impactful Work: Shape the future of AI-powered solutions that transform industries.

Collaborative Culture: Join a talented and passionate team that values open communication and innovation.

Ultralytics Handbook

Comprehensive guide to our company's mission, vision, values, and operational practices. This handbook is designed to provide key insights and resources for our (future) team members, collaborators, and community to align with Ultralytics' core principles.

Link: https://handbook.ultralytics.com/

title: Implementation Specialist - UKI Market
description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we’re on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We’re trusted by more than 10,000 companies worldwide, including Wise, On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we’re tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we’re driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you’re excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we’d love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. The Implementation Team is responsible for the onboarding of all our Premium and Pro customers on the Perk platform, and providing recommendations to optimize the customer experience. You'll use your platform expertise and stakeholder management skills to build a bridge between platform capabilities and customer expectations.   • Provide the first impression of Perk to all customers in your portfolio and serve as the first point of contact for customers during the implementation process.

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. This is an agentic, hands-on role -with support engineer roles as required. You will spend as much time in the lab and on the phone with suppliers as you will in a spec document.

 

What you'll do

  • Take working prototypes to shippable, field-deployable systems — define the product, own the roadmap, and drive it to delivery

  • Specify and build out over-the-air update infrastructure: firmware, versioning, rollback, fleet management, remote diagnostics

  • Own the design-for-manufacture transition — DFM/DFA reviews, BOM ownership, tolerancing, test fixtures, and production test protocols

  • Identify, qualify, and manage contract manufacturers and suppliers; own the relationship from RFQ through NPI to sustained production

  • Establish and enforce best-practice data capture protocols across modalities (EEG, fNIRS, EMG, pupillometry, motion capture, video) so that data quality is consistent across sessions, operators, and sites

  • Define the requirements that make in-the-wild collection viable: wearability, session setup time, robustness, battery life, and unattended operation

  • Work directly with our electronics, mechanical, firmware, and neuroscience teams to translate research needs into hardware requirements — and push back when a requirement doesn't survive contact with manufacturing

  • Build the quality, documentation, and regulatory groundwork (design history, ISO 13485-style discipline, CE/UKCA pathway) appropriate to a research-device product

  • Contribute to the industrialisation of our rodent recording platform where the manufacturing and OTA problems overlap

     

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Min 3+ years (ideal 7+) in hardware product management, product engineering, or programme management, with several products you personally took from prototype to volume manufacture

  • Direct, demonstrable experience with contract manufacturers: you have run RFQs, sat through NPI builds, argued about yield, and fixed a production line problem from 6,000 miles away

  • Experience with wearable, biosignal, or medical device hardware

  • Experience with multi-sensor time synchronisation and the data infrastructure behind it

title: Senior Technology Advisory Analyst
description: <div> <div class="description content">The Senior Technology Advisory Analyst serves as the&nbsp;<strong>fundamental pillar of AI-native advisory teams</strong>, empowering clients to navigate the critical junction of strategy and technical execution.</div> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <div class="skills inner-content"> <p>Collaborating with senior leadership and technical specialists, you will anchor the delivery process by <strong>framing challenges, validating hypotheses, and quantifying trade-offs</strong> to produce deliverables that are truly decision-ready for the executive level.</p> <p>By blending <strong>top-tier consulting rigor</strong> with an AI-native workflow, you enable senior teams to perform with <strong>unprecedented speed and depth</strong>, ensuring every strategic insight is backed by robust evidence and structural accuracy.</p> <p>This role transcends traditional requirements documentation; you are the <strong>engine of execution</strong> that translates high-level strategic intent into measurable, high-impact business outcomes.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>1. Drive Research and Analysis</strong></h3> <p>Perform core advisory and consulting activities including:</p> <ul> <li>Industry and market research</li> <li>Technology landscape assessments</li> <li>Business process analysis</li> <li>Data analysis and interpretation</li> <li>Competitive benchmarking</li> <li>Opportunity identification</li> </ul> <p>Leverage AI-enabled tools to accelerate research and analysis while maintaining high standards of quality and accuracy.</p> <h3><strong>2. Translate Business Problems into Actionable Insights</strong></h3> <p>Work with clients and engagement teams to:</p> <ul> <li>Understand business objectives and challenges</li> <li>Gather and synthesize qualitative and quantitative information</li> <li>Structure complex problems into manageable workstreams</li> <li>Identify patterns, risks, opportunities, and trade-offs</li> <li>Develop evidence-based recommendations</li> </ul> <h3><strong>3. Support Client Engagements</strong></h3> <p>Contribute to client-facing advisory work by:</p> <ul> <li>Preparing executive-ready presentations and deliverables</li> <li>Facilitating workshops and discovery sessions</li> <li>Documenting business and technology requirements</li> <li>Supporting strategic assessments and roadmap development</li> <li>Helping clients evaluate technology options and transformation opportunities</li> </ul> <h3><strong>4. Apply AI to Enhance Delivery</strong></h3> <p>Use AI responsibly to improve the speed and quality of advisory work by:</p> <ul> <li>Accelerating research and information synthesis</li> <li>Supporting analysis and content development</li> <li>Developing repeatable prompts and workflows</li> <li>Validating AI-generated outputs for accuracy and relevance</li> <li>Continuously improving how advisory work is delivered</li> </ul> <h3><strong>5. Ensure Quality and Delivery Excellence</strong></h3> <p>Review work products to ensure they are:</p> <ul> <li>Accurate</li> <li>Well-structured</li> <li>Insightful</li> <li>Client-ready</li> <li>Supported by evidence</li> </ul> <p>Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and risks before deliverables are shared with clients.</p> <h3><strong>6. Contribute to Continuous Improvement</strong></h3> <p>Help strengthen the Technology Advisory practice by:</p> <ul> <li>Capturing reusable frameworks, templates, and methodologies</li> <li>Sharing lessons learned across engagements</li> <li>Improving research approaches and analytical methods</li> <li>Contributing to internal knowledge assets and AI-enabled delivery practices</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></h2> <p>Success in this role means:</p> <ul> <li>Delivering high-quality analysis that enables better client decisions</li> <li>Producing clear, structured, and actionable deliverables</li> <li>Using AI effectively to increase team productivity without compromising quality</li> <li>Supporting Technology Advisory engagements that deliver measurable client value</li> <li>Building reusable knowledge and practices that improve future engagements</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Experience</strong></h3> <p>Typically 4–5 years of experience in one or more of the following:</p> <ul> <li>Management or technology consulting</li> <li>Business analysis</li> <li>Technology strategy</li> <li>Product or digital transformation</li> <li>Data, research, or analytics</li> </ul> <p>Experience working on technology-enabled business initiatives is highly valued.</p> <h3><strong>Capabilities</strong></h3> <p><strong>Business &amp; Technology Analysis</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong analytical and critical thinking skills</li> <li>Ability to connect business needs with technology solutions</li> <li>Comfortable working with ambiguity and complex problems</li> </ul> <p><strong>Structured Problem Solving</strong></p> <ul> <li>Breaks down complex challenges into logical components</li> <li>Synthesizes information into clear recommendations</li> <li>Thinks strategically while remaining detail-oriented</li> </ul> <p><strong>Communication</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication</li> <li>Creates executive-ready presentations and documentation</li> <li>Able to explain technical concepts to business stakeholders</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI-Enabled Ways of Working</strong></p> <ul> <li>Comfortable using AI tools to enhance research, analysis, and content creation</li> <li>Understands how to validate AI-generated outputs</li> <li>Continuously explores new ways to improve productivity through AI</li> </ul> <p><strong>Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Works effectively across multidisciplinary teams</li> <li>Partners closely with Technology Advisors, architects, designers, engineers, and client stakeholders</li> <li>Builds trusted relationships with clients and colleagues</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What Makes This Role Different</strong></h2> <p><strong>Senior Technology Advisory Analysts help clients navigate strategic technology decisions by combining analytical rigor, business understanding, and modern AI-enabled delivery practices.</strong></p> <p>Rather than simply documenting requirements, you help shape strategic recommendations, uncover insights, and accelerate advisory engagements. By combining consulting fundamentals with AI-powered ways of working, you enable teams to deliver deeper analysis, faster execution, and greater value for clients.</p> </div> </div> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3>Learning &amp; Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.</p> </div> </div> <h2 id="about">About Thoughtworks</h2> <div class="about content"> <p>Thoughtworks is a global technology consultancy that integrates strategy, design and engineering to drive digital innovation. For 30+ years, our clients have trusted our autonomous teams to build solutions that look past the obvious. Here, computer science grads come together with seasoned technologists, self-taught developers, midlife career changers and more to learn from and challenge each other. Career journeys flourish with the strength of our cultivation culture, which has won numerous awards around the world. <br><br>Join Thoughtworks and thrive. Together, our extra curiosity, innovation, passion and dedication overcomes ordinary.</p> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: center;"><a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment">See here our AI policy.</a></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Think ghost broking rings, organised misrepresentation, identity fraud, and patterns that only surface through deep, creative investigation.

  • Using tools like device fingerprinting, banking data, identity verification, quoting history and telematics to build evidence for cancellation

  • Analysing internal policy data at population level to identify emerging fraud trends before they become entrenched

  • Working with data science to develop and refine fraud detection models, network analysis tools, and automated alerting systems

  • Building and expanding fraud detection capability across the policy lifecycle

  • Working with AI tools and SQL to query data, spot patterns and accelerate investigations

  • Documenting investigations and producing intelligence reports for internal stakeholders and external bodies (IFB, IFED, CIFAS)

  • Mentoring and quality-assuring the work of more junior analysts in the team

  • You think like an investigator: you see connections others miss, and when something doesn't add up, you dig until you understand the full picture

  • You're confident making subjective judgements under uncertainty - fraud investigation rarely gives you a clean answer, and you're comfortable with that

  • You can operate at both the granular level (reviewing individual policies, documents, and data points) and the strategic level (spotting trends, proposing new detection approaches, challenging existing assumptions)

  • You communicate clearly and confidently - you'll need to explain complex fraud cases to stakeholders across the business and to external bodies

  • You're motivated by impact: removing bad actors from the book, protecting genuine customers, and building something that didn't exist before

  • Demonstrable experience identifying and disrupting fraud networks, not just reviewing individual policies

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data - SQL experience is strongly preferred

  • Familiarity with industry fraud data sources: IFB, CIFAS or equivalent

  • Experience producing intelligence reports and working with external fraud bodies

  • Comfort with AI tools and an appetite to use them — we AI tools extensively and expect this to grow

raw.title: Digital Marketing Executive
raw.description:
We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

The Marketing Team

Our Marketing team is at the centre of how a fast-growing tech brand shows up in the world. We turn strategy into output that reaches people and performs - across email, social, partnerships, and the website. We're a small, fast-moving team that uses AI as a default, not an afterthought, so we can move faster, automate the manual, and spend our time on the work that actually moves the needle.

As Marketing Executive, you'll work directly with our Senior Marketing Manager and have real visibility across the full marketing operation. You'll own key partner relationships, build and ship campaigns across our owned channels, and keep our performance reporting sharp and current. This is a role for someone who takes ownership, delivers to a high standard, and is accountable for their results.

What you'll be doing

  • Partner, Influencer & Affiliate Coordination: Own the day-to-day management of our Bronze and Silver tier affiliates and influencers - tracking performance weekly, keeping the partner tracker current, and flagging anything that moves. You'll coordinate onboarding, briefing, and deliverables, prepare materials to support contract negotiations, and help spot new partnership opportunities.

  • Owned Channel Execution: Build and deploy email campaigns in Braze - copy, design, segmentation, scheduling, and QA. Own the organic social content calendar, creating educational and entertaining assets for our customers. Build campaign assets in Figma using our brand templates, and support content production for the website and SEO alongside our growth function.

  • Campaign Delivery: Coordinate campaign workstreams and timelines across stakeholders, maintain campaign trackers, QA all outgoing materials before launch, and pull post-campaign data to share reports and learnings with the team.

  • Performance Reporting & AI Tooling: Build and maintain AI-assisted reporting workflows, automating wherever possible across email, social, and affiliate dashboards. Own our weekly performance dashboards and flag underperformance or anomalies before being asked.

Who you are

  • AI-Native: You actively use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, or equivalent) to draft copy, automate reporting, speed up research, and cut manual work. You don't wait to be told to use AI - you default to it.

  • A Builder: You ship things on time and to standard, and take pride in the output.

  • Data-Literate: You can pull, clean, and present performance data, and you know what questions to ask of it.

  • Organised: Multiple live workstreams don't faze you.

  • A Clear Communicator: You're not afraid to ask questions or challenge.

  • Commercially Curious: You want to understand your KPIs and where you can impact the business.

  • Brand-Consistent: You care that everything going out to customers meets our standards.

    What we're looking for

  • 1-2 years in a marketing, content, or digital role.

  • Hands-on CRM/email platform experience - ideally Braze.

  • Comfortable pulling and interpreting data from Looker or equivalent.

  • Strong written English.

  • Customer empathy and curiosity - you want to understand our audience and how to speak to them in a way that lands.

Nice to Have

  • Consumer tech or fintech background.

  • Social scheduling tool experience - Sprout, Buffer, Later, or native platforms.

  • Experience in Figma - able to produce campaign-ready assets independently without design support.

  • Experience working with influencers or partners.

  • Affiliate platform familiarity - Optimise or equivalent.

  • Campaign project management experience and tools - Notion or equivalent.

  • Experience writing for SEO or managing web content updates.

How success is measured

  • Execution quality: Campaigns and content land to a high standard, every time.

  • Delivery reliability: Launches happen on schedule. Workstreams stay unblocked.

  • Reporting cadence: Dashboards are current and insights are ready when needed.

  • Partner coordination: Partners feel well-managed. Comms are responsive and clear.

  • Data accuracy: Performance data shared is timely, clean, and trustworthy.

  • Proactive insight: You spot things before being asked and bring solutions, not just problems.

  • AI & tooling: Manual work is reducing. You actively bring new tools and workflows that make the team faster.

Growth

Marshmallow is growing fast, and this role grows with it. Strong performance here - sharp execution, commercial curiosity, and growing strategic instinct - is the path to a Senior Executive or channel lead role.

What the path looks like:

  • Master your channels: email, social, web, and affiliates running smoothly with minimal oversight.

  • Build your commercial instinct: understand the "why" behind every number you report.

  • Show initiative: bring ideas, spot gaps, and propose improvements before being asked.

  • Grow your AI fluency: automate more, move faster, create capacity to take on more strategic work.

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

raw.title: Data Science Manager, Pricing
raw.description:
We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

London (hybrid, 3 days in office)

Pricing at Marshmallow

The Pricing team shapes how we understand risk and make pricing decisions that support sustainable growth. It plays a critical role in Marshmallow’s ambition by protecting loss ratio performance and turning complex data into clear commercial action.

We work closely with claims, finance, product and other teams, to build a holistic view of risk and keep our pricing approach effective as we scale. The team acts as a key bridge between technical analytics and business strategy, helping Marshmallow stay ahead of market conditions and make confident decisions, even where data is sparse or uncertain.

The team works across modelling, business strategy and stakeholder communication. The challenge is balancing technical judgement with clear storytelling for very different audiences. It’s a team with high impact, high visibility and plenty of momentum.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning Marshmallow’s loss ratio view across our portfolio to understand performance and recommend commercial actions, factoring in both internal drivers and wider market, and economic conditions.

  • Leading conversations with internal and external stakeholders on pricing performance and risk trends, translating analytical outputs into clear pricing and portfolio insights for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Managing and developing a small group of pricing data scientists while raising the quality of their work.

  • Driving cross-functional investigation into claims and risk signals with partners across the business.

  • Shaping how pricing data scientists are deployed across workstreams as the team’s operating model evolves.

Who You Are

  • You’re commercially minded and enjoy connecting the dots between pricing decisions, financial outcomes and wider market conditions, not just the underlying data.

  • You’re comfortable using judgment in ambiguous situations, working with sparse or less credible data and making clear, well‑reasoned assumptions.

  • You’re naturally curious about why key metrics move, and you like to step back, challenge assumptions and tell a clear story behind trends and performance.

  • You collaborate easily with different teams (e.g. claims, finance, reserving) and communicate complex ideas in a concise, business-focused way.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience as a data scientist and/or data science manager in a risk-focused domain such as pricing, credit decisioning or fraud.

  • Experience operating in commercially driven environments where performance metrics guide decisions.

  • Experience forming clear, commercially grounded views off the back of technical analysis and communicating these clearly to senior stakeholders.

  • Experience making sound decisions when data is incomplete or imperfect, and comfortable operating under genuine uncertainty.

  • A collaborative approach, working seamlessly with adjacent functions, to connect pricing insights to broader business performance.

Perks of the job

  • Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance

  • Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva

  • Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year

  • Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

 

We are able to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

 

Our process

  • Initial call with a member from our Talent Team (30 mins)

  • Past Experience interview with Hiring Manager (60 mins)

  • Systems Design & Technical interview with a couple of the team (90 mins)

  • Culture interview (60 mins)

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

raw.description:
We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

About the role

This is a senior individual contributor role and the Controllership team's primary technical accounting expert. You will own the most complex and judgement-intensive accounting areas across the Group — spanning the UK insurance broker, claims handling, car finance and its associated SPV structure, and the Group holding company — and act as the go-to resource for the team, business stakeholders, and external auditors on technical accounting matters.

You will work with a high degree of autonomy, reporting directly to the Group Financial Controller. You are expected to solve complex problems independently, document and defend accounting positions to audit standard, coach more junior colleagues, and communicate clearly to senior stakeholders across Finance and the wider business. This role sits at the heart of the Group's effort to close legacy accounting gaps, maintain audit readiness, and build controls that scale as Marshmallow grows.

London (hybrid, 3 days in office)

What you'll own

Technical accounting across the Group

  • Own and maintain Group accounting policies across all entities in scope, ensuring alignment with FRS 102 and applicable regulatory requirements

  • Lead the Group's FRS 102 (2026 amendments) impact assessment and transition — with particular focus on revised revenue recognition and expected credit loss provisions across the business

  • Be the authoritative internal voice on complex, judgement-intensive areas across the Group including: share-based payments, capital development and intangibles, lease accounting, bad debt provisioning and impairment, periodic payment orders (PPOs), HP loan recognition and ECL provisioning, and SPV accounting

  • Own the technical accounting for the car finance business and its associated SPV structure

  • Own the technical accounting for the UK insurance broking and claims handling businesses

  • Drive resolution of legacy technical items and prior year audit findings — working through open issues to root-cause resolution rather than one-off workarounds

Revenue recognition — transformation workstream

  • Lead the documentation and review of revenue recognition policies across the business, ensuring they are accurate, consistently applied, and fit for audit scrutiny

  • Own the technical accounting perspective on the revenue data workstream — understanding how revenue flows are constructed, identifying any gaps between accounting policy and practice, and driving remediation where needed

  • Work cross-functionally with Engineering, Data, and FP&A to ensure the financial reporting of revenue is grounded in a robust and well-documented technical foundation

Insurance knowledge — Group-level review and challenge

  • Insurance industry knowledge is a core requirement of this role — while BAU technical accounting for the Group's insurance underwriting entity (based in Gibraltar) sits with a separate Finance team, you will be expected to review, challenge, and engage with Gibraltar Finance team from a Group perspective

  • This includes understanding earned premium, technical provisions, reinsurance accounting, and the financial reporting implications of the Group's insurance structures — and being able to apply that understanding in Group consolidation and in conversations with auditors

  • You will bring a Group finance lens to insurance-related accounting questions arising across the business

Audit readiness & accounting quality

  • Prepare and review complex balance sheet reconciliations and accounting entries across the entities in scope, maintaining the quality and evidencing standard required for external audit

  • Act as the primary Finance contact for external auditors on technical accounting judgements — prepare clear, well-evidenced documentation for complex or contested positions

  • Proactively identify and close accounting quality gaps, with a focus on sustainable fixes that hold up to scrutiny in future audit cycles

Coaching & cross-functional collaboration

  • Actively coach and develop more junior colleagues on technical accounting topics — raising the overall capability of the team is a genuine expectation of this role, not a secondary duty

  • Work alongside FP&A, Actuarial, Legal, and new business teams to embed technical accounting requirements early in product and process design

  • Support the Group Financial Controller in preparing clear technical accounting analysis for senior Finance stakeholders

What we're looking for

Technical accounting knowledge

  • ACA, ACCA or equivalent — fully qualified, with substantial post-qualification experience in a technical accounting or senior controllership role

  • Insurance industry knowledge is essential — you must have a working understanding of insurance accounting (earned premium, technical provisions, reinsurance structures) and be able to apply and challenge it at Group level from day one

  • Advanced, demonstrable command of FRS 102 and/or IFRS, with a track record of applying complex standards and documenting accounting judgements to audit standard

  • Experience with car finance or consumer credit accounting — HP income recognition, IFRS 9 / ECL, and ideally SPV or securitisation structures — is a strong advantage

  • Comfortable passing on technical knowledge and coaching colleagues — the expectation is that you actively raise the team's technical capability, not just your own output

Background & experience

  • Big 4 audit background is a plus, particularly with insurance or financial services clients — the ability to construct and evidence robust accounting positions is directly relevant to how this team engages with its auditors

  • Experience in a multi-entity group structure with consolidated reporting across UK GAAP / FRS 102

  • Prior exposure to FCA-regulated or insurance-regulated environments is strongly preferred

Data & systems

  • Advanced Excel; strong working knowledge of ERP systems — NetSuite experience is an advantage

  • Able to work with large and imperfect data sets; comfortable deriving well-supported conclusions where source data has gaps

  • Familiarity with BI tools such as Looker or Snowflake is useful but not required

How you work

  • Takes ownership of complex, multi-workstream problems and sees them through independently — escalates selectively and with good judgement

  • Presents highly complex analysis clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Proactively identifies control risks and improvement opportunities rather than waiting to be directed

  • Comfortable in an environment where process maturity is still developing — building rigour is part of the job, not an obstacle to it

Perks & benefits

  • Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance

  • Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva

  • Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year

  • Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

We are in a position to offer sponsorship and/or a visa for this position

Our process

Here's what to expect:

Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

 

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

We’re looking for an experienced Locum Ultrasound sonographer to join our multidisciplinary team in London and help to take ultrasounds as part of a clinical research study.

This is a key role focused on delivering high-quality, independent assessments. You’ll perform and interpret ultrasound scans of adult women who are receiving a breast ultrasound as part of a clinical study. You will work in conjunction with the principal investigator of the study to ensure that assessments and reports are of research-grade quality. This is a fixed term role that lasts for the duration of the study and is based at our clinics in London.

What You’ll Deliver

  • Perform high-quality diagnostic ultrasound examinations in line with clinical guidelines and best practices with focus on breast ultrasound

  • Pass on the study-specific acquisition and interpretation qualification task before performing study scans, with certificate filed in the investigational site file.

  • Independently interpret and report ultrasound findings, ensuring timely delivery of results that are uploaded to a standardised electronic case report form.

  • Collaborate with our multidisciplinary research team to help deliver Neko’s clinical trial focused on better understanding risks of breast cancer.

  • Adherence to the study acquisition SOP

  • Equipment QA maintenance logged on-site. Liaise directly with the study PI and research team where needed.

Minimum Requirements

  • HCPC-registered diagnostic radiographer (or other HCPC-/NMC-registered healthcare professional), holding a CASE-accredited postgraduate qualification in breast ultrasound (PgCert / PgDip / MSc, or a named CASE-accredited breast ultrasound module.

  • Documented, current breast ultrasound practice, with a minimum of two years’ full-time-equivalent breast scanning.

  • Advanced radiographic experience of reporting autonomously within the NHS Breast Screening Programme (NHSBSP) or an equivalent quality-assurance framework.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly to study participants.

  • Commitment to maintaining high clinical standards and engaging in ongoing professional development.

Preferred

  • Experience with previous ultrasound scanning as part of clinical trials

  • Experience with shear-wave elastography acquisition and reporting.

  • Experience with Philips US machines, and decision support software

  • Familiarity with data entry as part of clinical research studies.

About titles at Neko

We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so internal titles may differ from market‑facing role titles. Scope, impact and level of the role are fully aligned and will be clearly discussed throughout the process.

Hiring Process

Candidates progress from application and structured screening through thoughtfully designed interviews culminating in a formal offer and final pre-employment checks before joining the team.

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion Statement

Neko Health is committed to inclusive hiring and member-first care. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to request reasonable adjustments to support your application.
